description: The story body must sit within the 90 to 220 word range and its call to action must never use a link shortener such as bit.ly or lnkd.in.

input.proof_point: 40+ business units and 14+ ERP systems consolidated onto one governed semantic model

rubric.criterion: Word count within the required range
rubric.condition: The post body word count is at least 90 and at most 220 words, excluding the CTA line.

rubric.criterion: CTA is a single fully-qualified UTM link with no shortener
rubric.condition: The post body contains exactly one URL, starting with https://www.canvasintelligence.com/ and carrying utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign, with no link shortener present.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md hard rules 4 and 6.
